title: 第2585章 慕以言深爱慕念安好多年第2584章 不仅要在心里还要在眼前
lines: 厉衍瑾和夏初初，几乎是异口同声的说道：“在一起？”
这回，轮到夏天愣了一下。
她下意识的点点头：“是啊，在，在一起……爸妈，难道这件事你们……”
还不知道吗？
夏天咽了咽口水。
厉衍瑾和夏初初对视一眼。
两个人都从对方的眼神里，看到了满满的惊愕。
夏天也惊讶了。
这么大的事情，爸妈不知情？干爸干妈没有说吗？
为什么啊？
是觉得是家丑？
但，应该不太可能吧。
大家都是开明的人，思想不会那么的传统封建的。
“你好好说，把话说清楚。”厉衍瑾皱了一下眉，开口，“怎么回事？”
“就是……慕以言喜欢念安，而且喜欢好久好多年了。前两天，他，他带着念安，回到年华别墅，跟　干爸干妈摊牌了，公开的表示，他想要跟念安在一起。”
夏天把事情说清楚之后，夏初初错愕了。
“以言居然……一直以来他都喜欢，喜欢念安？”
这个组合……
夏初初都不知道，该说什么好了。
想想以前，言安希那么心心念念的想要把慕以言和夏天，给硬凑成一对。
但，结果很不理想。
现在，更是提都不怎么提这一回事了。
可是现在，突然一个这么大的重磅炸弹袭来，说，慕以言深爱慕念安好多年。
就是厉衍瑾，听到这里也都有些失态。
“以言喜欢念安？这……两个人的关系……”
夏天回答：“慕以言自己说，他早就知道，慕念安不是他的亲妹妹了。所以，这也只是表面上的关系。实际上并无血缘。”
一边的厉昊希，都到现在才缓过神来。
“以言哥……喜欢念安姐？这，这是什么情况？真的假的？我怎么不太相信呢？”
夏天看了他一眼：“我还能骗你不成？我以为爸妈早就知道这件事了，谁知道……”
慕家那边，都还没说。
而她先说出来了，反而还显得是她在这里多生事端一样。
现在怎么办啊。
“没想到啊没想到……”夏初初说，“慕以言的姻缘，竟然是在这里。”
厉衍瑾回答：“可是，慕迟曜和安希没有主动跟我们说起这件事，我也不好问。”
“额，”夏天有点尴尬，“那，爸妈你们就当不知道吧，也当我没有问起过。”
“不。”夏初初摇摇头，“没关系。你继续问吧，你想知道我和你爸爸的故事，然后告诉念安，让她有一个参考，是吗？”
“是的。妈。”夏天点点头。
content_en:
Li Yanjin and Xia Chuchu said almost in unison: "Together?"
This time, it was Xia Tian's turn to be stunned.
She nodded subconsciously: "Yes, here, together... Mom and Dad, are you doing this..."
Don’t know yet?
Xia Tian swallowed.
Li Yanjin and Xia Chuchu looked at each other.
Both of them saw full of surprise in each other's eyes.
Xia Tian was also surprised.
Don't your parents know about such a big thing? Didn’t your godfather and godmother tell you?
Why?
Do you think it's a family scandal?
But, it should be unlikely.
We are all enlightened people, and our thoughts are not so traditional and feudal.
"Speak carefully and speak clearly." Li Yanjin frowned and said, "What's going on?"
"It's just that... Mu Yiyan likes Nian An, and has liked her for many, many years. Two days ago, he took Nian An back to Nianhua Villa and had a showdown with his godfather and godmother. He publicly stated that he wanted to be with Nian An."
After Xia Tian made things clear, Xia Chuchu was stunned.
"Yi Yan actually...has always liked Nian An?"
This combination...
Xia Chuchu didn't even know what to say.
Thinking about the past, Yan Anxi was so obsessed with making Mu Yiyan and Xia Tian a couple.
However, the results were far from ideal.
Now, I don't even mention it anymore.
But now, suddenly such a big bombshell hit, saying that Mu Yiyan has been deeply in love with Mu Nianan for many years.
Even Li Yanjin felt a bit groggy when he heard this.
"Yi Yan likes Nian An? This... relationship between the two people..."
Xia Tian replied: "Mu Yiyan himself said that he knew a long time ago that Mu Nian'an is not his biological sister. Therefore, this is only a superficial relationship. In fact, there is no blood relationship."
Li Haoxi on the side has only now calmed down.
"Brother Yiyan... likes Sister An? What's going on? Is it true? Why don't I believe it?"
Xia Tian glanced at him: "Can I still lie to you? I thought my parents already knew about this. Who knows..."
The Mu family hasn't said anything yet.
And she said it first, but it still seemed like she was causing trouble here.
What to do now?
"I didn't expect, I didn't expect..." Xia Chuchu said, "Mu Yiyan's marriage would actually be here."
Li Yanjin replied: "However, Mu Chi Yao and An Xi didn't take the initiative to tell us about this matter, so it's hard for me to ask."
"Yeah..."
"Um," Xia Tian was a little embarrassed, "Then, parents, just pretend you don't know, and pretend I haven't asked about it."
"No." Xia Chuchu shook her head, "It doesn't matter. Just keep asking. You want to know the story about me and your father, and then tell Nian An so she can have a reference, right?"
"Yes. Mom." Xia Tian nodded.
title_en: Chapter 2585 Mu Yiyan has loved Mu Nianan deeply for many years Chapter 2584 Not only in the heart but also in front of the eyes
